About this space
Our spacious apartment with two bedrooms is suited for professionals travelling together or families in need of a quiet haven. Centrally located just off Rivonia Boulevard, Sandton.

Features:
- Complimentary high Speed Wi-Fi.
- Back up water
- Within walking distance to Rivonia Boulevard.
- Fully furnished, fully equipped, self catering & serviced.
- Two bedrooms furnished with Queen size bed and 2 x single.
- Sofa, TV & dining room table.
